metadata.title: Labelo
metadata.description: Labelo — calm projects, status rails, and full-screen labels for teams and agents.

localeBanner.message: Choose another country or region to see content specific to your location.

home.title: Welcome to Labelo
home.headline: Labels that move with your work
home.description: A calm home for projects, status rails, and full-screen labels—built for teams and ready for agents.

statement.title: Project. Rail. Label.
statement.description: One thought at a time—for your whole team.

pillars.title: Work together, one label at a time
pillars.description: Three calm surfaces that keep status clear without a crowded board.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Stack every initiative in a full-viewport home. Tap in when you are ready to focus.

rails.title: Status rails
rails.description: Statuses flow top to bottom so progress reads as a path, not a scatter of columns.

labels.title: Full-screen labels
labels.description: Each label gets the whole stage—write, move, and ship without the noise.

steps.title: Four steps to a calmer board
steps.description: From first sign-in to labels that move with your team.
steps.imageAlt: Blank paper labels hanging in a vertical rail beside the Labelo mascot

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Open Labelo with your account and land in a calm workspace.

team.title: Create or join a team
team.description: Start a team or enter an invite code to share projects.

project.title: Open a project
project.description: Pick a project from the vertical home and enter its status rail.

labels.title: Move labels
labels.description: Slide labels across statuses—one full-screen thought at a time.

cta.title: Open your workspace
cta.description: Sign in to create a team, join with an invite, and start labeling.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your sign-in details from Labelo. Change your language here; to update your name or email, use your identity provider.
profile.refreshHint: If something looks out of date, refresh the page after signing in again.

mcp.title: Personal MCP token
mcp.description: Create a personal token for Cursor (or other MCP clients) to manage projects and labels on teams you belong to.
mcp.pepperMissing: Token hashing is not configured. Set LABELO_MCP_TOKEN_PEPPER in the environment, then refresh.
mcp.copyOnceDescription: It will not be shown again.

onboarding.title: Set up your team
onboarding.description: Create a team to manage projects and labels, or join one with an invite code.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Open a project to move labels across the workflow.
projects.newDescription: Give your project a short name. You can add labels inside.
projects.name: Name
projects.emptyDescription: Create your first project to start organizing labels.
projects.deleteDescription: “{name}” and all of its labels will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

tasks.importDescription: Paste or upload a JSON file. Syntax is checked with AJV before anything is saved.
tasks.importFileHint: Choose a .json file exported from Labelo or matching the example.
tasks.importInvalidJson: That text is not valid JSON.
